linkedin.content:
Policy coding becomes much easier to review when every answer carries its evidence.

I made a tiny synthetic example with three passages and a frozen codebook. For each question it records the exact source locator, deciding excerpt, selected code, one-line rationale, and an ambiguity flag. A deterministic manifest makes the sample reproducible.

It is small on purpose: a reviewer can disagree with a code and point to the exact sentence instead of debating an opaque score.

Sample and builder:
https://github.com/lachlanchen/LazyPromotion/tree/main/examples/auditable-policy-coding

#ContentAnalysis #ResearchMethods #DataQuality #OpenSource
